stages.label: Checking that your data structure is ready

researcher_status.plain_language_title: Your research plan has not been confirmed yet
researcher_status.plain_language_summary: The research plan is currently 'still a draft'. The analysis can only run against a confirmed research plan.
researcher_status.why_it_matters: Running an analysis before the plan is confirmed could produce results that later have to be discarded when a decision changes.
researcher_status.next_action: Complete the outstanding decisions in the research plan and send it for confirmation. You can keep preparing data in the meantime.
researcher_status.resolving_role: Your supervisor or the person who confirms the research plan.

findings.plain_language_title: 2 decision(s) are needed before this analysis can run
findings.plain_language_summary: The following parts of the research plan are still waiting for a decision: The primary outcome; The multiple-testing correction.
findings.why_it_matters: These are scientific or governance choices. The runner will never fill them in on your behalf.
findings.next_action: Discuss the open decisions with your supervisor and record the outcome in the research plan. Nothing else needs to change.
